Subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule demo / technical deep dive

Hi Alex

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery:
- Primary use case: real-time customer support summarization + anonymized analytics for regulatory reporting.
- Key constraints: P95 latency under 150ms for short prompts, SOC 2 compliance required, model outputs must be auditable.
- Initial success metric: 20% reduction in average handle time (AHT) for Tier 1 support by Q4.

Next steps I suggested on the call:
1) Product demo + technical deep dive with your infra team to validate latency and data controls.
2) Share a short one-pager on architecture and hosting options.
3) If it looks good, put together a mutual action plan and pricing ballpark.

Are you available for a 60-minute demo + technical deep dive next week? Rafael (cc'd) will join to cover architecture and the Dedicated/Private deployment options.

Proposed times (PST):
- Tue 5/4 10:00-11:00 or 14:00-15:00
- Wed 5/5 09:00-10:00 or 13:00-14:00

If none of those work, please send a couple of slots that fit your team and I'll send a calendar invite with a Zoom link.

Attachments: Demo_OnePager.pdf (short architecture + hosting options)

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
